🚀 Cracking Big Data Engineering Interviews – My Personal Notes! 📚
Over the past two years, I’ve compiled and refined detailed notes on Big Data concepts, architecture, and best practices while working on real-world healthcare data engineering projects.
From Spark internals, Hadoop ecosystem, Hive optimization, to advanced SQL queries – I’ve covered 130+ high-impact topics that are frequently asked in interviews, including:
✅ Spark vs MapReduce
✅ DAG vs Lineage
✅ Spark Execution – Drivers, Executors, Stages
✅ Partitioning vs Bucketing
✅ Spark SQL vs HQL vs SQL
✅ File formats: Parquet, ORC, Avro
✅ Data Ingestion, Profiling & Validation
✅ Hadoop YARN Architecture
✅ Hive Optimizations & Map-Side Joins
✅ Sqoop Incremental Import, CDC, Split-by
✅ PySpark Code Examples & Common Interview Queries
